findings.observation: metadata.yml omits the required code_version field. It states objective, inputs, method, and environment, but declares no code version; the only version-like token (c018beef) appears solely inside results.json source strings, not in metadata. The increment is therefore not self-describing (CA-REPRO-001), and per CA-META-001 this absence is reported as a finding rather than inferred as compliant.

Plausibility concern, not a demonstrated internal contradiction: the reported counterpoise-corrected B3LYP/cc-pVDZ binding energy of -4.79 kcal/mol for the ammonia dimer is anomalously large in magnitude for this method level (CP-corrected values are typically around -2.5 to -3 kcal/mol; high-level reference ~-3.1 kcal/mol) and instead resembles a BSSE-uncorrected cc-pVDZ value, suggesting the counterpoise correction declared in metadata.yml may not actually have been applied. This cannot be confirmed from the four audited artifacts alone, so per CA-META-003 it is recorded as ADVISORY only. All other checks passed: units and sources present on all quantities (CA-DATA-001), convergence declared, threshold-consistent, and matching prose (CA-METH-002), exclusions disclosed and consistent, cited source run_018.py among declared inputs, and no cross-method-level comparisons made.
